name: The Fat Duck
dinnerNote: Tasting menu from (£285–£365 by menu and day), paid in full when booking
lunchNote: The same menus at lunch, Fri–Sun

menus.name: Tasting menu
menus.note: £285–£365 depending on the menu and the day; paid in full when you book; wine pairings from £155 to £1,050

alsoTry.name: The Hinds Head
alsoTry.note: Heston Blumenthal's pub next door in Bray, also suggested for a drink before dinner, as The Fat Duck has no bar

dressCode: No dress code; smart casual is suggested.
children: Children are welcome, but the menu isn't recommended for under-10s and there's no children's menu. Children count in the party size and pay the full menu price; ask the reservations team first.
duration: Allow about three to four hours.
bookingOpens: Online only, as tickets paid in full when you book. Dates are released in booking windows announced in the newsletter and on social media. Tables seat 1 to 6.

bookingWindow.note: Dates are released in booking windows announced in the newsletter and on social media.

waitlist: If your date is full, add yourself to the waiting list on the booking page's availability calendar.
cancellation: Cancelling within 7 days of the date, or not turning up, means no refund. Reservations can be passed to someone else. Drinks and a 15% service charge are paid on the day.
groups: Private hire for up to 40 guests: email reservations@thefatduck.co.uk.
